## ⚡ 360 REV — EPISODE #03 BLUEPRINT
### Connect Google Sheets & Gmail to Self-Hosted n8n in 2 Minutes

**🚀 1. Run This Workflow 24/7 (While Your Laptop is OFF):**
* [Launch Hostinger 1-Click n8n Cloud ($6.49/mo — Save $1,710/yr vs Zapier)](https://360rev-hub.github.io/hostinger?ep=ep03&src=json_sticky&cta=canvas_card)
* *In hPanel, select **Applications → Ubuntu 24.04 with n8n** (Coupon `MMVPS` / Partner Deal auto-applied).*

**📊 2. Copy-Paste Google Sheets Columns (Row 1 Headers):**
`Received_Date | Sender_Name | Sender_Email | Email_Subject | Summary_Snippet | Status`
* [Open Episode #03 Interactive Setup Hub & 1-Click Sheet Copy](https://360rev-hub.github.io/ep03/?src=json_sticky)

**🎥 3. Watch Video Setup Tutorial:**
* [Watch the 2-Minute Step-by-Step Video on YouTube (@360rev3)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ol6l8IFQQu8)

**🛠️ Architecture Highlights:**
* **Zone 1:** Connects to Gmail OAuth2 and filters out noreply/newsletter noise.
* **Zone 2:** Dynamically parses real `From` name, email address, subject, date & clean snippet from incoming Gmail payloads.
* **Zone 3:** Appends every client email into Google Sheets in real time.

## STEP 1: Connect Gmail OAuth2 & Filter Real Senders
1. Double-click **1. Watch Incoming Emails (Gmail)** -> click **Sign in with Google**.
2. **2. Filter Out No-Reply / Spam** ensures only real human/business emails are logged.

## STEP 2: Real Dynamic Sender & Subject Parser
1. **3. Parse Real Sender Name, Email & Snippet** splits `"Name <email@domain.com>"` into clean separate columns and strips HTML tags from the email preview.

## STEP 3: Sync to Google Sheets 24/7
1. Double-click **4. Append Row to Google Sheets** -> select your spreadsheet.
2. Flip the top-right switch to **Active** on your [Hostinger 1-Click n8n Cloud](https://360rev-hub.github.io/hostinger?ep=ep03&src=json_step3)!
